tips.title: Mission preparation checklist
tips.summary: A spoiler-safe checklist to prepare before a difficult mission.
steps: Choose a suitable vehicle and save nearby.
Check objectives before committing to a route.

tips.title: Build cash without wasting upgrades
tips.summary: Prioritize reliable income and purchases that improve future earning.
steps: Complete available activities before luxury purchases.
Keep a reserve for mission equipment.

tips.title: Learn each vehicle class
tips.summary: Handling changes with weight, road surface, and speed.
steps: Practice one route with different vehicle classes.

tips.title: Search the world methodically
tips.summary: Use landmarks and map zones so you do not repeat the same areas.
steps: Divide the map into small zones.
Check rooftops, alleys, coastlines, and interiors.
Record discoveries in your mission tracker.

tips.title: Tune controls before long sessions
tips.summary: Small sensitivity and camera changes can improve consistency.
steps: Change one setting at a time.
Test it in a safe area.
Keep it only if it feels better after several minutes.
